sources.title: [2301.06267] Multimodality Helps Unimodality: Cross-Modal Few-Shot ...
sources.snippet: The ability to quickly learn a new task with minimal instruction - known as few-shot learning - is a central aspect of intelligent agents. Classical few-shot benchmarks make use of few-shot samples from a single modality, but such samples may not be sufficient to characterize an entire concept class.
